speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Huntington's Disease. The combination of chorea (involuntary movements), cognitive decline (forgetfulness), psychiatric symptoms (hallucinations, depression), and the positive HTT gene mutation with caudate atrophy on MRI confirms this diagnosis. I recommend genetic counseling and referral to a neurologist specializing in movement disorders immediately.
